'''Quarrenese''', also refererred to as '''Quarren''', was the official language of the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] species.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

Quarrens were mostly bilingual in both Quarrenese and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], although many of them also learned [[Mon Calamari (language)/Legends|Mon Calamarian]]. Converesly, many [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] learned Mon Calamarian, Basic, and Quarrenese.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /> Quarrenese was also extended in planets with notable colonies of Quarrens.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref> Quarrenese had more words to describe gemstones and their qualities than most other languages.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
